arrivals rise, who gets paid? 
Regressing the quarterly proportionate YoY growth in each airline ’s passengers against 
the proportionate YoY growth in tourist arrivals since 2014 (CAAT data, 2020 -22 excluded) 
answers that question cleanly. Pearson correlation s of 0.99 for THAI and 0.88 for AAV,
